final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode", "y"], ["1", "slow", "2"]) == ["slow", "3", "1", "2"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var names: List[str] = []
  var others: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
    else
      if k == "level"
        level = copy v
      else
        var found = -1
        for j in range(0, names.len())
          if names[j] == k
            found = j
        if found < 0
          names.append(copy k)
          others.append(copy v)
        else
          others[found] = copy v
  var out: List[str] = []
  out.append(mode)
  out.append(level)
  for o in others
    out.append(copy o)
  out
